title_en: Qiu Huinan v. State — state compensation dispute
keywords_en: state compensation; criminal compensation; first instance; intermediate people's court; Jiangsu Province; natural person; State Compensation Law; compensation obligation for erroneous arrest; return of confiscated property; remedy for infringement of reputation rights; partial support; suspected misappropriation of public funds; erroneous arrest; deprivation of personal freedom; property confiscation; damage to reputation
full_text_en:
Qiu Huinan v. Siyang County People's Procuratorate — state compensation case

Compensation Claimant: Qiu Huinan, male, 50 years old, former Factory Director of Siyang County Compound Fertilizer Factory, Jiangsu Province.

Compensation Obligor: Siyang County People's Procuratorate, Jiangsu Province.

Legal Representative: Wei Zhenghu, Chief Procurator.

Agent ad litem: Tang Chunyu, Deputy Section Chief of the Complaint and Appeal Section, Siyang County People's Procuratorate.

Review Authority: Huaiyin City People's Procuratorate, Jiangsu Province.

Legal Representative: Liu Qun, Chief Procurator.

Agent ad litem: Cheng Anmei, Section Chief of the Complaint and Appeal Section, Huaiyin City People's Procuratorate.

Compensation Claimant Qiu Huinan, on the grounds that the Siyang County People's Procuratorate wrongly convicted him, resulting in his deprivation of personal freedom for 569 days and that compensation should be paid, filed a compensation application with the Compensation Committee of the Huaiyin Intermediate People's Court, requesting that the Siyang County People's Procuratorate compensate him for various economic losses totaling over RMB 160,000, return the confiscated cash of RMB 18,050, eliminate the adverse effects, restore his reputation, and make a formal apology.

The Compensation Committee of the Huaiyin Intermediate People's Court found through trial: Compensation Claimant Qiu Huinan was originally the employed Factory Director of Siyang County Compound Fertilizer Factory. On June 6, 1994, the Siyang County People's Procuratorate decided to place the case on file for investigation on suspicion that Qiu Huinan had misappropriated public funds. On June 10, residential surveillance was imposed. From June 8 onward, Qiu Huinan was detained at the Siyang County Agricultural Science Institute, with his personal freedom restricted. On August 1, he was placed under criminal detention, and from August 11, he was arrested on charges of "misappropriation of public funds," and was broadcast on the "Siyang News" program of Siyang Television Station and on cable radio. On December 28, 1995, the Siyang County People's Procuratorate announced to Qiu Huinan the Decision on Exemption from Prosecution, Document No. 10 of Jian (95) Xing Er Mian Zi, determining that Qiu Huinan had committed the crime of misappropriation of public funds, exempting him from prosecution and releasing him. Qiu Huinan was dissatisfied and, upon release, immediately filed a complaint with the Huaiyin City People's Procuratorate. On April 17, 1996, the Huaiyin City People's Procuratorate issued the Decision on Review of Criminal Appeal, Document No. 03 of Huai Jian Kong Shen Fu Jue (1996), determining that Qiu Huinan did not constitute the crime of misappropriation of public funds and revoking the Decision on Exemption from Prosecution issued by the Siyang County People's Procuratorate against Qiu Huinan. Accordingly, from July 3, 1996, Qiu Huinan successively filed a compensation application and a compensation review application with the Siyang County People's Procuratorate and the Huaiyin City People's Procuratorate. Neither the Compensation Obligor, the Siyang County People's Procuratorate, nor the Review Authority, the Huaiyin City People's Procuratorate, made a decision within the statutory time limit as to whether to grant compensation to Compensation Claimant Qiu Huinan.

It was further found that, during the handling of the case, the Siyang County People's Procuratorate confiscated property of Qiu Huinan in the amount of RMB 18,050 as "illegal proceeds." During the period of detention, Qiu Huinan incurred medical expenses of RMB 590.45.

The Compensation Committee of the Huaiyin Intermediate People's Court held: The Siyang County People's Procuratorate imposed residential surveillance, criminal detention, and arrest on charges of "misappropriation of public funds" on Compensation Claimant Qiu Huinan. This case has been lawfully rectified by the Huaiyin City People's Procuratorate. Pursuant to Article 2 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China, the victim, Qiu Huinan, has the right to obtain state compensation in accordance with the law. The decisions to impose compulsory measures on Qiu Huinan were all made by the Siyang County People's Procuratorate. Pursuant to Article 19, paragraphs 1, 2, and 3 of the State Compensation Law, the Siyang County People's Procuratorate is the Compensation Obligor. Qiu Huinan filed a compensation application and a compensation review application with the Compensation Obligor and its superior Review Authority, but received no reply within the statutory time limit. He then filed an application with the Compensation Committee of the People's Court at the same level as the location of the Review Authority for a compensation decision. This complies with the compensation procedures set forth in Chapter 3, Section 3 of the State Compensation Law, and the People's Court shall accept the case. This case arose from the procuratorial authority exercising its functions and powers in handling a criminal case, and therefore the provisions on criminal compensation in the State Compensation Law shall apply. The Siyang County People's Procuratorate imposed erroneous compulsory measures on Qiu Huinan, who had no criminal facts, actually detaining him for 569 days, thereby infringing on Qiu Huinan's personal rights. Pursuant to Article 15, items (1) and (2) of the State Compensation Law, Qiu Huinan has the right to obtain compensation. Pursuant to Article 26 of the State Compensation Law, the daily compensation amount for the period during which Qiu Huinan was deprived of personal freedom shall be calculated based on the average daily wage of employees nationwide in the preceding year. During the handling of the case, the Siyang County People's Procuratorate confiscated Qiu Huinan's personal lawful property under the pretext of "recovery of illegal proceeds," thereby infringing on Qiu Huinan's property rights. Pursuant to Article 16, item (1) of the State Compensation Law, Qiu Huinan has the right to obtain compensation. Pursuant to Article 28, item (1) of the State Compensation Law, the Siyang County People's Procuratorate shall return the property. The Siyang County People's Procuratorate publicly disclosed Qiu Huinan's so-called "crimes" in the news media before a trial had determined guilt, thereby infringing on Qiu Huinan's right to reputation. Pursuant to Article 30 of the State Compensation Law, the Siyang County People's Procuratorate shall bear the responsibility of eliminating the adverse effects, restoring reputation, and making a formal apology. Compensation to Qiu Huinan shall only be calculated in accordance with the standards prescribed by the State Compensation Law. Qiu Huinan's claim for indirect economic losses lacks legal basis and is not supported by the court. Accordingly, the Compensation Committee of the Huaiyin Intermediate People's Court decided on March 25, 1997:

1. The Siyang County People's Procuratorate shall pay Qiu Huinan compensation for the infringement of his personal freedom for 569 days in the amount of RMB 14,785, plus the medical expenses of RMB 590.45 incurred during his detention, totaling RMB 15,375.45, to be paid in a lump sum in cash through this Court within one month after this decision takes effect.

2. The Siyang County People's Procuratorate shall return the cash of RMB 18,050 confiscated as illegal proceeds during the handling of this case, plus interest of RMB 418.08.

3. The Siyang County People's Procuratorate shall, within the scope of the adverse effects caused by its infringing acts against Qiu Huinan at that time, eliminate the adverse effects, restore his reputation, and make a formal apology.

4. The application of Compensation Claimant Qiu Huinan for compensation for other indirect economic losses shall not be compensated in accordance with the law.

The Siyang County People's Procuratorate has already fulfilled all payment obligations determined in the compensation decision.
